positions.title: Software Development Engineer & Founding Engineer
description: Early-stage startup building an AI-powered device infrastructure PaaS unifying real and virtual device execution (one of the first engineers hired).
Built production Python/FastAPI services with Redis Pub/Sub for event-driven communication, supporting 150+ Android and iOS devices across allocation, automation, logging, and session workflows.
Designed and led the iOS platform implementation, owning streaming, device interaction, recording, and IPA resigning infrastructure from scratch for 50+ iOS devices.
Built the log-embedding pipeline for an internal AI-powered RCA system, using vector-database retrieval to analyze distributed microservice logs and surface relevant failure patterns.
Built an Android observability pipeline using ADB Logcat, Redis Pub/Sub, Fluent Bit, and Elasticsearch, reducing representative log volume by ~80% (98K → 20K lines) with retention controls.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
description: Reduced redundant frontend API calls by 30% using state management and Redis caching; contributed to an SPA migration reducing observed routing time from 300 ms to 20 ms.
